entities.summary: Nam Ji-sung is a South Korean tennis player. He has a career high ATP singles ranking of world No. 236 achieved on 12 August 2019. 102 achieved on 3 February 2020. In 2024, he became the first Korean in 13 years to win the Busan Open in doubles.
